content: मन्दर {%a.%} .²1 Slow, tardy, dull. .²2 Thick, dense; firm. .²3 Large, bulky. .{@-रः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a mountain (used by the gods and demons as a churning stick when they churned the ocean for nectar); पृषतैर्मन्दरोद्धूतैः क्षीरोर्मय इवाच्युतम् <ls>R. 4. 27</ls>; अभिनवजलसुन्दर धृतमन्दर ए <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>; शोभैव मन्दरक्षुब्धक्षुभिताम्भोधिवर्णना <ls>Śi. 2. 107</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 30</ls>. .²2 A necklace of pearls (of 8 or 16 strings). .²3 Heaven. .²4 A mirror. .²5 One of the five trees in Indraʼs paradise; see मन्दार. .{@-रम्@} {%ind.%} Slowly, sluggishly.
